clues.text: Before a battle, Israel camped at this place while the Philistines camped at Aphek.
After fighting near Israel's camp at this place, the Philistines struck down about four thousand Israelite men.
Beaten by the Philistines, Israel's elders sent to Shiloh for the ark of the covenant to join their camp here.
Eli's sons Hophni and Phinehas came with the ark of the covenant to Israel's camp at this place.
The Philistines carried the captured ark of God from this place to Ashdod.
Samuel gave a stone this name, saying, "Thus far the LORD has helped us."
After the LORD thundered against the Philistines, Samuel set up a stone with this name between Mizpah and Shen.
